notes: Taleb's barbell: 85-90% of invested money very safe, 10-15% very risky. The share is of invested money, not of salary.
50/30/20 budgeting splits income; the barbell splits savings. They do not clash.
Index investing (Bogle) disagrees with the barbell: it says the diversified middle is the best trade-off.
A course that leads to a raise is an explore bet with more upside than most stock picks.
